title: Rubber duck with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='45%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE04D'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFCC00'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#E6A800'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='headGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF176'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#FFD600'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#F0B400'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- water splash -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='42' ry='8' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='38' ry='6' fill='#29B6F6'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='68' rx='30' ry='22' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='60' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#FFF59D' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M78 62 Q92 52 86 44 Q82 50 76 54 Z' fill='#E6A800'/>
  <path d='M80 60 Q90 54 86 48 Q83 52 78 55 Z' fill='#FFD600'/>

  <!-- wing -->
  <path d='M58 66 Q72 60 74 70 Q70 78 58 76 Q54 72 58 66 Z' fill='#F0B400'/>
  <path d='M60 68 Q68 64 70 70 Q67 75 60 74 Q57 71 60 68 Z' fill='#FFCA28'/>

  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='42' y='42' width='20' height='14' rx='6' fill='#FFD600'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='36' r='20' fill='url(#headGrad)'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='29' r='7' fill='#FFFDE7' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M28 38 Q20 40 22 46 Q26 48 34 44 Z' fill='#FF8F00'/>
  <path d='M28 40 Q23 42 24 46 Q28 46 33 44 Z' fill='#FFB300'/>
  <!-- upper beak -->
  <path d='M30 34 Q22 36 24 41 Q30 40 36 38 Z' fill='#FFA000'/>
  <path d='M30 36 Q24 37 25 40 Q30 39 34 37 Z' fill='#FFC107'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='32' r='4.5' fill='#FF6F00'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='31' r='2.5' fill='#3E2723'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='30.5' r='0.9' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- smile on cheek -->
  <path d='M36 42 Q40 47 46 45' stroke='#E65100' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- water ring details -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='88' rx='6' ry='2' fill='#81D4FA' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='89' rx='5' ry='1.5' fill='#81D4FA' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
